source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique IB identity; paired OOB review confirms scoped 0x0C/0x21 SOL permission lifecycle.

source_snapshot.procedure: Disable SOL with App 0x0C/0x21 channel 0x01 0x00 via IB/OOB and test session, then enable with 0x01 0x01 and test; generic pre-step clears logs.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL but lacks exact guarded workflow.

original_test_intent: Disable and enable SOL payload permission on one approved channel, independently prove denial and admission with an owned session, and restore the original state.
original_method: Use protected App 0x0C/0x21 for one verified channel/transition at a time, with full SOL/access/session baseline and independent recovery.
manual_activity: Owner approves one transition and expected admission result; operator verifies no protected session and confirms recovery immediately before action.
agent_execution_scope: Read back and test owned session

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct classification but incomplete; source supplies bytes yet needs verified channel, safe transport, session ownership and recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected raw 0x0C/0x21 plus complete sol info/access/session readback and dedicated admission probe.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original disable/enable bytes and 10/5 timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute disable and enable as separately approved checkpoints, read back full state, prove denial/admission using only an owned session, and restore the captured baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds checkpoints, recovery and safe credentials without reducing functional coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: sol info alone is partial evidence and cannot replace controlled session admission behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong channel/state can remove or expose console access.

project_override_considerations: Alternative tools require equivalent per-channel permission, admission/denial and restore evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source chains disable/enable without approval checkpoints or original-state restore, uses unsafe OOB credentials and clears logs; channel and existing-session effects are unspecified.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Commands and behavior are explicit; safe target/session/recovery inputs are readiness conditions.

review_improvement: Makes each SOL transition independently authorized and measurable while preserving denial and admission coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a high-impact but defined management-session configuration test. Real writes and session behavior are essential, so it requires package, confirmation and recovery rather than read-only substitution or permanent blocking.
